dataset.name: Brazil dengue (chap-models/chapkit_ghr_model)
dataset.description: Monthly notified dengue cases, population, mean temperature and drought index (scPDSI) for 11 microregions of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil: GHRmodel's dengue_MS data (same values as Lowe et al. 2021), from chap-models/chapkit_ghr_model.
dataset.notes: Made by tools/make_example_data.R in chapkit_ghr_model from GHRmodel's bundled dengue_MS (complete cases only; last 3 months, 2019-10 to 2019-12, held out as future_data.csv). Data check: all 2475 rows match Lowe et al. 2021 data/data_2000_2019.csv on micro_code and month: disease_cases = dengue_cases, population = population, pdsi = pdsi, mean_temperature = (tmax + tmin) / 2. Locations are IBGE microregion codes 50001 to 50011 (all in Mato Grosso do Sul); a microregion is a statistical group of municipalities inside a state, not an official admin level, so admin_level 2 is the closest level. No rainfall column (dengue_MS has none).
dataset.schema_status: filled from source code/docs and data checks; not independently verified

source.provider: IBGE via GHRmodel dengue_MS / Lowe et al. (2021)

fields.name: disease_cases
fields.description: Notified dengue cases (SINAN) in the microregion, by month of first symptoms.

source.provider: SINAN / DATASUS via GHRmodel dengue_MS (Lowe et al. 2021)
source.notes: make_example_data.R: disease_cases = dengue_cases. Equals Lowe dengue_cases for all rows.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Estimated population of the microregion (projections from the 2000 and 2010 censuses and 2007 and 2017 counts).

source.provider: IBGE / DATASUS via GHRmodel dengue_MS (Lowe et al. 2021)
source.notes: Lowe data_desc.csv 'population'. Equals Lowe population for all rows.

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: Midpoint of monthly average daily maximum and minimum temperature ((tmax + tmin) / 2), CRU TS 4.04 0.5° grid averaged over the microregion.

source.provider: CRU TS 4.04 via GHRmodel dengue_MS (Lowe et al. 2021)
source.notes: make_example_data.R: mean_temperature = (tmin + tmax) / 2; Lowe data_desc.csv gives tmax/tmin in °C from CRU TS 4.04. Equals Lowe (tmax + tmin) / 2 to 5e-14.

fields.name: pdsi
fields.description: Self-calibrated Palmer Drought Severity Index, mean over the microregion (dimensionless; negative = drier than usual, positive = wetter).

source.provider: CRU scPDSI via GHRmodel dengue_MS (Lowe et al. 2021)
source.notes: Lowe data_desc.csv 'pdsi'. Equals Lowe pdsi for all rows.
